project.visitorDecision: After choosing one of the eight Circle Tour source-backed stops, which documented starting place fits my outing, what is uncertain about the approach and what single map destination should I open?
project.primaryAction: Choose Nipigon Marina or Red Rock, Cascade wayside or park office, or Temperance gorge or Lutsen resort when appropriate; read the selected source and then open only that arrival's map action.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: Parks Canada identifies a 2.6-km Red Rock Lloyd's Lookout return hike and a 10.1-km one-way full trail. This does not establish currently open trails, transfer service or a guaranteed Google Maps match.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: DNR describes the Lookout Mountain route from a day-use parking area. The separate park-office address is not proven to be that trailhead.

claims.subject: parking-rule
claims.limitation: May 2026 construction advisory only. It does not verify open or closed parking in November 2026 or at a future visit.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: The Circle Tour does not integrate live trail, parking, operator or traffic checks. Follow posted restrictions and official updates before travel.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: A user-initiated Google Maps search for a named place, intersection or street is a convenience, not a surveyed parking pin or guarantee that the provider resolved the intended entrance.

decisionState.selectedIdField: model.stopId plus explicit entry index in state.arrivalChoices[stopId]
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Original CircleTourPage selected stop/itinerary plus static source-reviewed officialArrivals catalog; chooseArrival is a pure bounded selector. No live parking data is ingested.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Unsupported theme hides unrelated park arrivals and offers explicit reset; one-source stops have no unnecessary selector; invalid ctArrival returns to default; no-JS and catalog failure retain original 31-stop guide and static links.

scenarios.input: Open stop 19 Nipigon with the default visit choice
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Nipigon Marina and its named-place map search are visible with one Parks Canada source; the alternative Red Rock choice is a native button, not a second competing map link.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Named searches cannot guarantee a precise lot or availability.

scenarios.input: Select Red Rock with keyboard Enter
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The active title, 2.6-km return lookout versus 10.1-km one-way warning, map destination and official source change together without losing keyboard focus.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The trail is not certified open and a return ride must be independently planned for the full hike.

scenarios.input: Select Red Rock, switch to Temperance, then return to Nipigon; reset to Marina
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Per-stop choice returns to Red Rock; reset returns to the Marina map. ctArrival stays paired with ctStop, and no option leaks to another park.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Sources and address-versus-search precision follow the active choice.

scenarios.input: Disable JavaScript for the entire Circle Tour
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: 31 original stop cards, official road and independent specialist links remain readable; no fabricated selected parking claim.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The enhanced arrival selector itself is unavailable without JavaScript and does not replace the static original stop guide.

scenarios.input: Block third-party map tiles and external map providers
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Destination notes, named source references, and selected arrival remain usable without live Google Maps imagery or an embedded map.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: External Google map links are navigation handoffs; no route line or parking coordinate is drawn on the Circle Tour page.

scenarios.input: Block the static specialist catalog request or inspect a dated May 2026 Cascade notice
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Catalog error retains the original static guide, and a historical construction notice is not turned into a current parking status.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The absence of a current lot-level observation is explicit.

scenarios.input: Select ships at Cascade River then recover to all interests
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The waterfall arrival desk is not shown for ships; the visitor can restore the documented park outings with a single reset.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No irrelevant source link is misrepresented as a ships specialist.

scenarios.input: Open an arrival deep link with out-of-range or mismatched stop ID
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: A bounded default arrival or no arrival appears without inventing a third starting area, while original trip state survives.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: ctArrival alone never permits a different kind of map direction.

failures.no-js: Keep the original 31-stop route cards, static vetted source links, map and itinerary instructions; do not promise a client-selected parking destination.
failures.no-tiles: The active selected-arrival card remains a readable source-linked destination when the map provider or tile images are blocked.
failures.no-image: Photo failures remove only that Place & Story figure. The selected arrival decision and official map-source pair remain usable without photographs.
failures.stale-data: The approved static catalog failure reveals original fallback links; dated MnDOT works cannot assert a current lot closure or reopening.

qa.scopeNote: PR Chromium must inspect at 360,390,768,1366,1440: one active start, keyboard focus, A-B-A stop choice, deep-link hydration, theme mismatch, photo isolation, map-source match, no overflow, no-JS, catalog failure. Run URL and independent screenshot review are not yet confirmed.
